reviews.text: Titanium Restoration was an excellent choice! From the first consultation to the final payment I received nothing but professional treatment. The roof was installed quickly and the work site completely cleaned of debris in one day! People in my community walk by my home and stop to look at it. I get compliments on the color match which happens to be the only color on my street. Thank you Titanium Restoration for a job well done. I recommend my project manager Carlos for his company's Service Award!!
reviews.author: Donna

reviews.text: I'm very pleased with my roof replacement. They offered great support from beginning to end. The company did everything they promised and answered any questions I had in a timely manner. I highly recommend them to anyone needing this service.
